chunks: And with this chain of narrators, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah, from Abu Yahya al-Wasiti, from Abdullah ibn Yahya ibn Abdillah al-Alawi, that he ascribed it, saying:
It was said to Allah’s Messenger (peace be upon him and his Family): What is the community of your nation? He said: Those who are on the truth, even if they were ten.
ai.seo_question: What defines the true community of the Prophet according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Mani al-Akhbar*, this hadith clarifies the concept of *al-Jama'ah* by prioritizing doctrinal fidelity over numerical majority, a key distinction in Shia theology against groups that equate community with sheer numbers. It underscores that the true path is preserved even by a small minority, reinforcing the Shia emphasis on the Ahl al-Bayt and the Imams as the guarantors of the truth regardless of external political or social dominance.
